tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅/ mi g.yo ba'i bstod pa 'thad ldan bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ dad pas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas nas// mi g.yo mi bskyod mi 'khrug brtan pa po// mkha' mnyam sems can 'dul bar mdzad pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i khro chen rgyal por bstod par bgyi// chos nyid rang bzhin nam mkha'i mdangs ldan zhing*// ro gcig dbu dang bden gnyis phyag zhabs mdzes// mthon mthing ral pa'i cod paṇa tshogs kun rdzogs// nyi ma mtha' yas gzi ldan khyod la 'dud// drang srong chen po khro tshul rab tu grims// spyan gsum 'jig dus me yi 'od dang mtshungs// thugs rje'i rab khros mche bas ma mchu mnan// chu bdag rin chen gyis brgyan khyod la 'dud// shes rab ral gris bdud dpung nges 'joms g.yas// sdigs mdzub zhags pas nyon mongs tshogs 'joms g.yon// bdud kyi snying gar g.yon pa'i lha nga btsugs// dpa' bo'i gar gyis bzhugs la bdag phyag 'tshal// thugs kyi bdag pos spyi bor rab brgyan pa// yi ge bcu pas srid gsum zil mnan zhing*// nyon mongs sreg mdzad me yi dbus na brjid// 'khrul byed bcom ldan gtso la mgos phyag 'tshal// sprul pa sku lnga gnyis med sku bcu'i dngos// mtha' yas sku lnga ye shes lnga yi mdog /re re'ang kha dog du ma'i mdangs ldan zhing*// zhi dang sgeg dang rab khros mdzad la 'dud// mtha' yas dbu rnams 'dzum dang bzhad cing khro// mtha' yas spyan ldan spyan gsum gnyis dang gcig /spyan med dpral ba'i mche bas don kun 'grub// ljags 'dril rab gtsigs ma mchu mnan la 'dud// phyag rnams du mas phyag mtshan mtha' yas 'dzin// zhabs rnams du mas dpa' bo'i bzhugs stangs dang*// phyed krung brkyang bskum sgeg cing ldem pa yis// bdud dang log 'dren gnon la bdag phyag 'tshal// rin chen mi rus mi mgo sbrul gyis brgyan// mi dang seng ge glang chen stag lpags dang*// sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas rab mdzes shing*// dpa' bo ngur smrig bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// a ḍa ha sa ha sas rab bzhad cing*// hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭa ṭas bdud kyi klad pa 'gems// swā hās sdug bsngal can rnams skyob mdzad pa// sna tshogs gsung gis 'gro don mdzad la 'dud// rang bzhin chos sku'i dbyings las mi bskyod cing*// ye shes lnga yi thugs ni brtan pa po// thugs rje chen po nyid las mi g.yo ba// mtshan don thugs kyi dbyings la bdag phyag 'tshal// khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyis sprul pa'i phyir// bde gshegs kun gyi yon tan khyod yin pas// khyod kyi yon tan brjod par su yis nus// mkha' mnyam yon tan tshogs mnga' khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi bran du zhal bzhes nas// khyod kyi phrin las rgyal ba kun mchod cing*// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dgongs rdzogs mdzad phyir// mkha' mnyam sems can sgrol mdzad khyod la 'dud// sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa sgeg pa'i sku// bdud dang log 'dren ma lus 'dul mdzad pa// shin tu rab khros khro gnyer mi sdug pa// rnam 'phrul du ma'i sku ldan khyod la 'dud// dbyangs dang gsal byed nga ros rab bzhad cing*// de dag las btus rig sngags du ma ni// drag shul dang bcas 'jigs su rung ba yis// bdud rnams 'joms mdzad dbu ldan khyod la 'dud// thugs rjes sems can mtha' yas tshogs bsgral zhing*// sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'i ngam pa can// chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las mi bskyod thugs// nyams dgu'i yon tan ldan la bdag skyabs mchi// khyod sku dran zhing gsung gi rig sngags kyis// bdag gi nyon mongs sdug bsngal bsal mod kyi// khyod sku dran pas btang snyoms bgyis lags gang*// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyod la bzod par gsol// 'on kyang bdag gis gang la 'bad gyur pa// mi bskyod thugs kyi rigs gyur 'ba' zhig ste// mi g.yo brtan pa'i rang bzhin khyod nyid pas// 'di la bzod gsol ci 'tshal byin gyis rlobs// 'di ltar bu tsha rab tu sdug bsngal bas// ji ltar khros kyang pha mar rab brtse zhing*// phan pa'i gnas la rab tu 'jog pa ltar// bdag la rtag tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lo 'ga' btang snyoms bzod par gsol ba dang*// dpal chen 'od pos gsol ba btab gyur nas// thugs rje'i khro chen rgyal por bstod bgyis pa'i// dge des 'gro kun khyod dang mnyam par shog
/rje btsun mi g.yo mgon po'i bstod pa/ rim pa gsum pa 'thad par ldan pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba'o// rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
